in_marathi.name: Dwarkadas
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Dwarka
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dwarkadas हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dwarkadas is a Sanskrit name that is a combination of two words - Dwarka and Das. Dwarka means 'a place of refuge' and Das means 'servant' or 'slave'. So, Dwarkadas means 'Lord of Dwarka' or 'Servant of Dwarka'. This name is significant in Hindu mythology as Lord Krishna is said to have resided in Dwarka, making this name a revered one.
